name: Booking.com
summary: 거리·조용함·가격처럼 내가 따지는 조건으로 숙소를 비교하고, 무료 취소 되는 곳 예약과 변경·취소까지 두리에게 맡길 수 있어요.

example.ask: 다음 달 제주 가족 여행 3박, 바다 보이는 숙소 4명
example.reply: 애월 바닷가 리조트가 1박 21만 원, 평점 8.9예요. 체크인 5일 전까지 무료 취소돼요. 예약할까요?

abilities.title: 조건으로 비교

en.name: Booking.com
en.summary: Compare stays by what you care about, such as distance, quiet and price. Dool2 books free-cancellation rooms and changes or cancels them.

example.ask: 3 nights in Jeju next month for 4, with a sea view
example.reply: A seaside resort in Aewol is ₩210,000 a night, rated 8.9. Free cancellation until 5 days before. Shall I book it?

abilities.title: Compare by what matters
abilities.say: Only places with breakfast and a pool

abilities.title: Book
abilities.say: Book that one with free cancellation

abilities.say: Shorten the Tokyo hotel by a day
